title: Inkling Notes
shortDescription: Capture thoughts as Markdown notes without leaving Command Palette. Type, press Enter, and the idea is already on disk.
description:
Inkling turns Command Palette into the fastest note-taking surface on Windows. Assign an alias, summon the palette, type the alias to jump straight into the capture page, type your thought, press Enter — the idea is saved as a plain Markdown file before the window even closes.

Everything lives in a folder you choose, as ordinary .md files with stable IDs in their front matter. Change a note's title and the file keeps its identity; bring your own existing Markdown files and they simply show up in the list. There is no database, no lock-in, and nothing between your notes and your favorite editor, sync tool, or backup.

- Quick capture: your alias opens a dedicated page, and everything you type there becomes the note — title and body split on a separator you choose, previewed live before you commit.
- Notes list: search, preview, edit, copy the body, open in your editor, reveal the file, or delete (straight to the Recycle Bin, not the void).
- Plain Markdown: unknown front matter fields are preserved untouched, so Inkling plays well with Obsidian, VS Code, or anything else that reads .md.
- Fully keyboard-driven: every action has a shortcut, designed around the palette's always-focused search box.
